content:
Power is the rate at which work is done or energy is transferred over time.

It tells us how fast something can do work or use energy. Power works by dividing the amount of work done by the time it takes to do it.
A student lifts a 100 N box to a height of 2 meters in 5 seconds. How much power did the student use?

Given:
		F = 100 N
		d = 2 m
		t = 5 s
		P = ?

Where:
		P = Power (Watts)
		W = Work (Joules)
		t = Time (seconds)
		F = Force (Newtons)
		d = Distance (meters)
